steps.en: OCMS recognises that the registered address has changed
steps.id: OCMS mengenali bahwa alamat terdaftar berubah
steps.why_en: Addresses are not compared, so a change is not recognised.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pembandingan alamat, jadi perubahan tidak dikenali.

steps.en: The latest address becomes the individual's letter address
steps.id: Alamat terbaru dijadikan alamat surat individu
steps.why_en: The letter address may be refreshed by routine checks, but not triggered by a detected change.
steps.why_id: Alamat surat bisa terbarui lewat pengecekan rutin, tetapi tidak dipicu oleh perubahan yang terdeteksi.

steps.en: OCMS resends the reminder to the individual
steps.id: OCMS mengirim ulang reminder ke individu
steps.why_en: No automatic resend process exists when the address changes.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses kirim ulang otomatis saat alamat berubah.

steps.en: OCMS creates the reminder file for the print vendor
steps.id: OCMS membuat file reminder untuk vendor cetak
steps.why_en: A file is made in general, but not automatically and not triggered by an address change.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan file ada secara umum, tetapi tidak otomatis dan tidak dipicu perubahan alamat.

steps.en: The file is sent to the vendor to be printed and posted
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor untuk dicetak dan dipos
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is switched off in the production settings, so the letter may not go out.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, jadi surat belum tentu sampai.
